clue.text: Bang on the forehead

parts.note: reads like a blow to the head, but bangs in American English are hair cut straight across the brow

explanation.definitionFit: Hair cut short and straight across the brow is called this in Britain and bangs in America.

clue.text: Butler I re-employed did something constructive again

indicators.note: re-employed means used again in a new way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A butler taken back on staff does some building work.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuild is to construct again, so the past tense means did construction once more.

clue.text: Rain at a locale encompassing part of republic

indicators.note: encompassing means the words contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: Weather report: rain falling over a district of a country.
explanation.walkthrough: The republic is South Africa; this is one of its provinces.
explanation.definitionFit: Natal, now KwaZulu-Natal, is a province of the Republic of South Africa.

clue.text: Ivy maybe will make original woman jealous about start of relationship

indicators.note: about means the two pieces together surround the letter

parts.note: Eve was the first woman in the Bible
green, as in green with envy, means jealous

indicators.note: start of means the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A woman is told her ex will be jealous of a new romance.
explanation.walkthrough: Ivy here is a plant, not a woman's name; 'about' has the original woman and jealous together go round the first letter of relationship.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy keeps its leaves all year, so it is an example of an evergreen plant.

clue.text: One million for each? It's indecent

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
pro means for, in favour of
per means each, as in a pound per head

explanation.surface: A remark that a million apiece is being charged, followed by a complaint that this is shocking.
explanation.definitionFit: Indecent behaviour is improper: it breaches standards of propriety.

clue.text: Conclude there's no end for fire

indicators.note: end puts the word no at the end of the answer, after the other piece

parts.note: to infer is to conclude from evidence

explanation.surface: Decide that a fire will never go out.
explanation.definitionFit: An inferno is a large, raging fire.

clue.text: One might have a pointed fixation for her

definitions.text: One might have a pointed fixation for her

parts.words: One might have a pointed fixation for her
parts.note: reads as an obsession with a woman, but means a drawing pin holding up her poster

explanation.definitionFit: A pin-up is a picture of an attractive woman fixed to a wall, often with drawing pins.

clue.text: Lapse in supervision

definitions.meaning: an omission or slip from not noticing something
watchful charge or management of something

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an unintended slip and the act of overseeing.

clue.text: Ernest confused about a Pakistani perhaps

indicators.note: about means the rearranged name goes round the single letter
confused means the letters are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: A man named Ernest is bewildered by someone from Pakistan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confused' muddles ERNEST into ESTERN, which wraps round A.
explanation.definitionFit: Pakistan is in Asia, so a Pakistani is an example of an Eastern person.

clue.text: One who finds things hard to grasp

definitions.text: One who finds things hard to grasp

parts.words: One who finds things hard to grasp
parts.note: reads as someone slow to understand, but means someone who literally keeps dropping things

explanation.definitionFit: A clumsy person who drops whatever they hold is called this, as if their hands were greased.

clue.text: One from the country taking beer after ten to seven

indicators.note: after places the beer behind the time piece in the answer

parts.note: ten to seven is six fifty, which in Roman numerals is VI and L
lager is a type of beer

explanation.surface: A countryman has a beer at ten to seven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ten to seven' looks like a clock time, and it is: 6.50, written as Roman VI L.
explanation.definitionFit: A villager lives in a village, so is someone from the countryside.

clue.text: Starfish

parts.note: not the sea creature but a star sign whose symbol is a pair of fish

explanation.walkthrough: Split the word: a 'star' (zodiac sign) that is a 'fish'.
explanation.definitionFit: This zodiac sign is represented by two fish, so it is a fish among the stars.

clue.text: Principal way plea is amended

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: amended means altered, so the letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: The main road has a petition revised.
explanation.definitionFit: A staple food or product is the principal or chief one.

clue.text: Salesman turns up with past actor

indicators.note: in a down clue turns up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
former means past, earlier

explanation.surface: A travelling salesman arrives with an old thespian.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor is a performer on stage or screen.

clue.text: Co-operative may be compelling

definitions.meaning: putting someone under an obligation, forcing

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both helpfully accommodating and, as a verb form, binding someone by duty.

clue.text: Drop off for a visit here

definitions.text: Drop off for a visit here

parts.words: Drop off for a visit here
parts.note: reads as calling in somewhere, but drop off means falling asleep

explanation.definitionFit: This imaginary place is where you go when asleep, from a biblical name punned on nodding off.

clue.text: Alien goes beyond point, getting cut off

indicators.note: goes beyond places the alien word after the point in the answer

parts.note: E is east, a compass point
alien means strange, foreign

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial passes a marker and is isolated.
explanation.definitionFit: To estrange someone is to alienate or cut them off from others.

clue.text: Trick sounds daft first, it's elementary

indicators.note: first puts the word for daft before the trick in the answer
sounds says the pieces are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: daft means silly
a con is a trick or swindle

explanation.surface: A con that seems foolish at first is simple to see through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sounds' applies to the word for daft, said aloud and spelt SILI; 'first' puts it before the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Silicon is a chemical element, so it is elementary in the chemistry sense.

clue.text: I may leave medicine that's dispensed for native

indicators.note: may leave says this letter goes from the pool before rearranging
dispensed means the medicine is made up, so its letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A patient says they may walk out on medicine that is handed out locally.
explanation.walkthrough: Take I out of MEDICINE and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Endemic species are native to a particular region.

clue.text: Warning at thawed rink?

parts.note: a thawed rink is not ice any longer
a skating rink is a surface of ice

explanation.surface: A caution posted at a skating rink that has melted.
explanation.walkthrough: A thawed rink is literally 'not ice'; the question mark flags the whimsy.
explanation.definitionFit: A notice is a posted warning or announcement.

clue.text: Fuss caused by flirt

definitions.meaning: a commotion or to-do, as in what a palaver
to have an affair or dalliance

explanation.walkthrough: Both senses are informal British: a big fuss, and to carry on with someone romantically.
explanation.definitionFit: A carry-on is a fuss, and to carry on with someone is to flirt or have an affair.

clue.text: Using maximum effort at end of innings?

definitions.meaning: in cricket an innings ends when ten batsmen are dismissed

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a team is described this way when all its batsmen have been dismissed, closing the innings.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means total effort, and in cricket it describes a side with no batsmen left.

clue.text: Cultivation of incline on top of hill

parts.note: to tilt is to incline or slope

indicators.note: in a down clue top of means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Farming a slope at the summit of a hill.
explanation.definitionFit: Tilth is the cultivation of land, or the condition of tilled soil.

clue.text: Comedy with classic car filling empty day

indicators.note: filling means the car goes inside the other piece
empty means the inside letters are removed, leaving only the outer two of day

parts.note: Roller is slang for a Rolls-Royce, a classic car

explanation.surface: A comic film features a vintage car during an otherwise dull day.
explanation.walkthrough: Roller is British slang for a Rolls-Royce; 'classic car' suggests a vintage model generally.
explanation.definitionFit: Drollery is humour or comic quality, a form of comedy.

clue.text: The Continental worker had an inclination

parts.note: le is French for the
a worker ant is the stock crossword worker

explanation.surface: A European employee had a preference.
explanation.definitionFit: Leant is the past tense of lean, to incline or tend towards.

clue.text: Sounds like this medicine is free

indicators.note: sounds like says the word is heard rather than spelt as written

parts.note: complementary medicine is alternative therapy such as acupuncture

explanation.surface: A claim that a certain remedy costs nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: Complementary (with an E) medicine is pronounced the same as the word meaning given free.
explanation.definitionFit: Complimentary items are given free of charge.

clue.text: Chaotic when a new chief's in charge

parts.note: arch means chief, as in archenemy

explanation.surface: Things go haywire when a fresh boss takes over.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchic means lawless and disordered, without control.

clue.text: Going to court? Attorney can start to grill

parts.note: DA is a district attorney in the US
a tin is a can

indicators.note: start to means only the first letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A lawyer about to cross-examine someone in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court' suggests law, as does 'Attorney', but here it means woo.
explanation.definitionFit: To court someone is to woo them, which is what dating involves.
